entries.summary_en: Tencent reported Q2 results on August 12: revenue rose 11% year on year and non-IFRS attributable profit rose 9%, but IFRS attributable profit increased only 0.7%, AI capex rose 176%, and free cash flow turned negative. Overnight US trading favored AI cloud, servers, storage and optical links over software. A/H focus: Tencent, CPO/optics, AI servers, storage and energy defense.
entries.html:
重大新闻汇总
国际
中东航运与油价风险仍是早盘估值上限
8月12日公开报道显示，红海、曼德海峡和霍尔木兹相关安全事件继续抬高能源安全溢价，IEA也提示全球油品库存快速消耗；A/H 映射到中海油、中国石油、油服、航运成本和通胀交易。
国际
美国通胀符合预期后纳指小涨，美债仍限制高估值扩张
AP 报道8月12日标普500涨0.3%、纳指涨0.5%、道指微跌，10年期美债在4.68%附近；风险偏好修复但不是全面降息交易，恒生科技和A股成长仍需看成交与美元/离岸人民币方向。
科技
隔夜 Sparks 显示存储与英伟达持仓链领涨
Futunn Sparks 正数 Top5 为存储概念 +6.72%（SKHY +9.01%）、英伟达持仓概念 +6.58%（NBIS +34.14%）、太空概念 +6.09%（ATRO +17.33%）、加密矿企 +4.42%（CANG +27.33%）、OLED 概念 +4.19%（AMAT +4.29%）；A/H 映射优先看存储、算力服务器、CPO/OLED材料与半导体设备。
科技
AI云与服务器财报强反馈继续支撑硬件链
公开报道显示 Nebius 因二季度收入与EBITDA超预期大涨约34%，CoreWeave 与 Super Micro 均涨约19%；这强化 GPU 租赁、AI服务器、液冷、电源、PCB 和光互连需求，A/H 映射工业富联、浪潮信息、中际旭创、新易盛、沪电股份等。
科技
软件股相对承压，AI交易从应用端回到基建端
Barron's 报道 Palantir 跌约2.2%、Microsoft 跌约2.3%，Salesforce、ServiceNow、Workday等软件股也走弱；这说明隔夜资金更偏向芯片、云算力、服务器和光通信，A/H 软件与SaaS只适合等待价格确认。
科技
光通信与半导体精选仍有延伸，但高位需要量能验证
Sparks 中光通信 +1.76%（LITE +13.63%）、半导体精选 +2.27%（MU +4.92%），与AI基建财报形成同向验证；A/H CPO、存储和设备股若高开后缩量回落，应视为卖事实而非突破。
财报
腾讯二季度收入增11%，AI投入压低利润与现金流
腾讯官方8月12日晚公布2Q2026：收入2047.85亿元、同比增11%，Non-IFRS归母净利684.15亿元、同比增9%；IFRS归母净利560.22亿元、同比仅增0.7%，资本开支527.84亿元、同比增176%，自由现金流为负138亿元。基本面韧性与AI投入并存，今日0700.HK开盘价格反应是恒生科技核心验证。
财报
可验证 A/H 权重财报主要集中在腾讯
本机 Futu OpenD 127.0.0.1:11111 拒绝连接，HK/SH/SZ earnings calendar 与 NOTICE 子项受限；公开来源确认腾讯为昨晚最重要A/H/HSTECH权重财报，未确认阿里、美团、小米、中芯国际、华虹等同窗口正式业绩结果，因此不使用美股公司财报补位。

盘前结论

今日最强正反馈来自隔夜 AI 基建链：存储、英伟达持仓、AI云、服务器、光通信和半导体设备同时获得价格或财报验证。但软件股走弱和油价风险说明风险偏好并非全面扩张，高估值成长需要成交量确认。

腾讯财报是恒生科技的核心变量：收入、游戏、广告和云服务仍有韧性，但AI资本开支与负自由现金流会压制利润率叙事，0700.HK若低开后承接，才可带动平台互联网修复。

Futu OpenD 未启动导致本地日历和公告子检查受限，已按规则降级；盘中仍需补看交易所公告和南向资金，避免把美股财报当作A/H财报结果。

重点个股推荐

腾讯控股
0700.HK
财报验证

推荐理由：腾讯是今日最重要HSTECH权重财报，收入、游戏、广告和云服务仍有韧性，能直接影响恒生科技情绪。

触发因素：2Q收入同比增11%、Non-IFRS归母净利同比增9%，同时AI产品和云需求带来长期叙事。

风险点：IFRS归母净利仅增0.7%、capex同比增176%且自由现金流为负，若开盘放量走弱，应降级为观察而非追多。

中际旭创
300308.SZ
CPO映射

推荐理由：AI基建财报和光通信Sparks同向，CPO仍是A股对美股AI硬件最直接的映射。

触发因素：LITE +13.63%、光通信 +1.76%，叠加CRWV/SMCI/NBIS强反馈。

风险点：板块已处高位，若高开缩量或龙头冲高回落，容易触发卖事实。

工业富联
601138.SH
服务器链

推荐理由：AI云、服务器和英伟达持仓链同时领涨，服务器制造、液冷、电源和PCB有望获得映射。

触发因素：NBIS +34.14%、CRWV和SMCI均约+19%，验证AI资本开支仍在硬件端兑现。

风险点：如果A股算力硬件高开后成交不能放大，说明资金只做隔夜映射而非趋势扩散。

兆易创新
603986.SH
存储最强

推荐理由：Sparks存储概念 +6.72% 是隔夜最强映射，A股存储芯片和模组链具备开盘弹性。

触发因素：SKHY +9.01%、MU +4.92%，AI服务器需求强化存储价格和库存周期预期。

风险点：若存储价格、订单和业绩没有同步验证，主题可能从强映射变成短线兑现。

中国海洋石油
0883.HK
能源对冲

推荐理由：中东航运与油价风险仍高，能源高股息可对冲科技高估值波动。

触发因素：IEA库存警示、红海和霍尔木兹安全事件、油价风险溢价。

风险点：若油价快速回落或谈判缓和，能源股可能从防御转为高开回吐。

板块轮动看板

受益方向存储、AI服务器、CPO光通信、OLED材料、半导体设备、能源高股息。
观察方向腾讯与平台互联网、港股云服务、低空/太空概念、加密金融情绪映射。
压力方向软件/SaaS、高估值消费成长、家居零售、缺乏业绩兑现的主题股。
验证信号0700.HK开盘承接、恒生科技成交额、CPO龙头放量、SOXX/SMH相对纳指强弱、油价亚洲盘。

逻辑链

美国CPI符合预期带来风险修复，但美债和油价仍限制A/H高估值成长的估值扩张。
隔夜Sparks和公开报道显示AI交易集中到存储、云算力、服务器、光通信和半导体设备。
腾讯财报提供本地权重验证：核心收入韧性支撑平台情绪，AI投入和现金流压力限制单边乐观。
软件股承压说明AI应用端估值被重新审视，A/H软件和SaaS应弱于硬件映射链。
若腾讯和CPO/存储龙头同时放量承接，恒生科技和A股科技可延续修复；若仅高开无量，则能源防御和低估值方向更稳。

风险雷达

腾讯卖事实

若市场更关注AI capex、负自由现金流和IFRS利润低增长，平台权重可能压制恒生科技。

AI硬件拥挤

NBIS、CRWV、SMCI、LITE涨幅较大，A/H映射股若高开回落，会触发板块兑现。

能源通胀尾险

中东航运事件若继续推高油价，会重新抬升通胀预期和美债收益率。

软件负反馈扩散

美股软件股下跌若延续，港股云服务和A股软件应用可能弱于硬件链。

Futu子项受限

OpenD端口拒绝连接，今日A/H公告日历需盘中继续核验交易所公告。

entries.html_en:
Major News
International
Middle East shipping and oil risk still cap opening valuations
August 12 public reports showed Red Sea, Bab el-Mandeb and Hormuz security events continuing to lift the energy-security premium, while the IEA warned that oil-product inventories are being rapidly depleted; A/H mapping runs through CNOOC, PetroChina, oil services, shipping costs and inflation trades.
International
Nasdaq rose after in-line US inflation, but Treasury yields still restrain high multiples
AP reported that on August 12 the S&P 500 rose 0.3%, the Nasdaq gained 0.5%, and the Dow edged lower, with the 10-year Treasury near 4.68%; risk appetite improved, but this is not a broad easing trade, so HSTECH and A-share growth still need turnover plus dollar/offshore-yuan confirmation.
Technology
Overnight Sparks shows storage and Nvidia-holder chains leading
Futunn Sparks positive Top5 were Data Storage +6.72% (SKHY +9.01%), Nvidia Holdings +6.58% (NBIS +34.14%), Space +6.09% (ATRO +17.33%), Crypto Miners +4.42% (CANG +27.33%), and OLED +4.19% (AMAT +4.29%); A/H mapping should prioritize storage, AI servers, CPO/OLED materials and semiconductor equipment.
Technology
Strong AI cloud and server earnings feedback keeps supporting hardware
Public reports showed Nebius rising about 34% after Q2 revenue and EBITDA beat expectations, while CoreWeave and Super Micro each gained about 19%; this reinforces demand for GPU rental, AI servers, liquid cooling, power, PCB and optical interconnects, mapping to FII, Inspur, Zhongji Innolight, Eoptolink and Wus Printed Circuit.
Technology
Software underperformed as AI trading shifted back to infrastructure
Barron's reported Palantir down about 2.2% and Microsoft down about 2.3%, with Salesforce, ServiceNow and Workday also weaker; overnight capital preferred chips, cloud compute, servers and optical links, so A/H software and SaaS should wait for price confirmation.
Technology
Optical links and semiconductors can extend, but high levels need volume
Sparks also showed Optical Communication +1.76% (LITE +13.63%) and Selected Semiconductors +2.27% (MU +4.92%), aligning with AI infrastructure earnings; if A/H CPO, storage and equipment names gap up then fade on light volume, treat it as sell-the-news, not a breakout.
Earnings
Tencent Q2 revenue rose 11%, but AI spending compressed profit and cash flow
Tencent's official August 12 release showed 2Q2026 revenue of RMB204.785 billion, up 11% year on year, and non-IFRS attributable profit of RMB68.415 billion, up 9%; IFRS attributable profit was RMB56.022 billion, up only 0.7%, capex was RMB52.784 billion, up 176%, and free cash flow was negative RMB13.8 billion. Business resilience and AI investment coexist, making 0700.HK's opening reaction the key HSTECH test.
Earnings
Verifiable A/H heavyweight earnings centered on Tencent
Local Futu OpenD refused 127.0.0.1:11111, limiting HK/SH/SZ earnings-calendar and NOTICE checks; public sources confirmed Tencent as the main post-close A/H/HSTECH heavyweight result, with no verified same-window formal results from Alibaba, Meituan, Xiaomi, SMIC or Hua Hong, so US-company earnings are not used as A/H earnings filler.

Pre-Market View

The strongest positive feedback today comes from overnight AI infrastructure: storage, Nvidia-holder names, AI cloud, servers, optical links and semiconductor equipment all have price or earnings validation.But weaker software shares and oil risk show risk appetite is not broad-based, so high-multiple growth needs turnover confirmation.

Tencent earnings are the core HSTECH variable: revenue, games, advertising and cloud remain resilient, but AI capex and negative free cash flow pressure the margin story; only a supported 0700.HK open can lift platform-internet repair.

Futu OpenD was not running, limiting local calendar and notice sub-checks, so the run degraded under the rules; exchange notices and southbound flows still need intraday confirmation, and US earnings are not treated as A/H earnings results.

Focus Stocks

Tencent Holdings
0700.HK
Earnings test

Rationale: Tencent is today's most important HSTECH heavyweight result, and its revenue, games, advertising and cloud resilience can directly affect HSTECH sentiment.

Trigger: Q2 revenue rose 11% year on year and non-IFRS attributable profit rose 9%, while AI products and cloud demand keep the long-term narrative alive.

Risk: IFRS attributable profit rose only 0.7%, capex rose 176%, and free cash flow was negative; if the stock opens weak on volume, downgrade it to watch instead of chasing.

Zhongji Innolight
300308.SZ
CPO mapping

Rationale: AI infrastructure earnings and optical Sparks point in the same direction, leaving CPO as the most direct A-share map to US AI hardware.

Trigger: LITE +13.63% and Optical Communication +1.76%, combined with strong CRWV, SMCI and NBIS feedback.

Risk: The sector is already elevated; a light-volume gap or leader reversal would trigger sell-the-news pressure.

Foxconn Industrial Internet
601138.SH
Server chain

Rationale: AI cloud, servers and Nvidia-holder names all led, giving server manufacturing, liquid cooling, power and PCB a mapping bid.

Trigger: NBIS +34.14%, with CRWV and SMCI each about +19%, validating AI capex through hardware.

Risk: If A-share compute hardware gaps up without expanding turnover, capital is only trading the overnight map, not trend broadening.

GigaDevice
603986.SH
Storage leader

Rationale: Data Storage +6.72% was the strongest overnight mapping lane, giving A-share memory chips and modules opening beta.

Trigger: SKHY +9.01% and MU +4.92%, with AI-server demand strengthening memory-pricing and inventory-cycle expectations.

Risk: If storage pricing, orders and earnings do not confirm, the theme can quickly turn from strong mapping to short-term profit taking.

CNOOC
0883.HK
Energy hedge

Rationale: Middle East shipping and oil risks remain elevated, making high-dividend energy a hedge against high-multiple technology volatility.

Trigger: IEA inventory warnings, Red Sea and Hormuz security events, and crude-risk premium.

Risk: If oil falls quickly or negotiations ease, energy shares can give back defensive gains after a high open.

Sector Rotation Board

Strength to WatchStorage, AI servers, CPO optics, OLED materials, semiconductor equipment and high-dividend energy.
Watch ListTencent and platform internet, Hong Kong cloud services, low-altitude/space themes, and crypto-finance sentiment maps.
PressureSoftware/SaaS, high-multiple consumer growth, home-improvement retail and themes without earnings delivery.
Signals0700.HK opening support, HSTECH turnover, CPO leader volume, SOXX/SMH relative strength versus Nasdaq, and Asia-session crude.

Logic Chain

In-line US CPI supports risk repair, but Treasury yields and oil still restrain valuation expansion for A/H high-multiple growth.
Overnight Sparks and public reports show AI trading concentrated in storage, cloud compute, servers, optical links and semiconductor equipment.
Tencent earnings provide the local heavyweight test: resilient core revenue supports platform sentiment, while AI spending and cash-flow pressure limit one-way optimism.
Software-share weakness shows AI application valuations are being reassessed, so A/H software and SaaS should lag hardware mapping chains.
If Tencent and CPO/storage leaders both hold on volume, HSTECH and A-share technology can extend repair; if the move is only a light-volume gap, energy defense and low valuation are steadier.

Risk Radar

Tencent sell-the-news

If investors focus on AI capex, negative free cash flow and slow IFRS profit growth, the platform heavyweight can weigh on HSTECH.

AI hardware crowding

NBIS, CRWV, SMCI and LITE already moved sharply; if A/H mapping names gap then fade, the sector will face profit taking.

Energy inflation tail

If Middle East shipping events keep lifting crude, inflation expectations and Treasury yields can rise again.

Software feedback spreads

If US software weakness persists, Hong Kong cloud services and A-share software applications may lag hardware chains.

Futu sub-checks limited

OpenD refused the local port, so today's A/H notice calendar still needs intraday exchange-announcement checks.
